info.title: API.SH: Darty
info.description: The Darty API from API.SH: public Darty data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
The products of a Darty category in the same shape as search, with the category's filters and its `category_id`. Give the category number (`cat`) or a darty.com category link; sorts, filters and later pages work with either (a link costs one extra page read to find its category). Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/darty-listing

parameters.name: cat
parameters.description: Darty category number (`category_id` in answers), e.g. 26055 for laptops.

parameters.name: filters
parameters.description: Filter values from `facets[].values[].filter`, several separated by |.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Every offer for a Darty product: Darty itself, Darty refurbished and marketplace sellers, with seller name, id, rating and origin, condition and its description, price and comparison price, discount, services (warranty, returns), eco fees, delivery and pick-up promises and the offer link. Sort by price, seller rating or delivery time.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/darty-offers

parameters.name: codic
parameters.description: Darty product number (`codic` in search results and products), e.g. 8219516.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

example.title: Cafetière Tassimo Bosch TAS103E 1400 W Happy Rouge

get.description:
One Darty product: codic, title, family, labels, price and struck-through price, condition, seller, eco fees, monthly payment offer, the other offers shown on the page (refurbished and marketplace) and the lowest offer price, review count and rating summaries, strong points, all specifications, description, images, videos and breadcrumbs.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/darty-product

get.description:
Customer reviews of a Darty product, 20 per page: rating, title, text, review and purchase dates, where it was bought (store or online), the reviewer's first name, full name and postcode as the review shows them, and stated product mastery, pros and cons; with the average rating, review count, per-criterion scores and the share of customers who recommend it. After-purchase reviews by default, long-term reviews with `type=long_term`. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/darty-reviews

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Search darty.com (France): products with Darty's product number (codic), title, family, brand and reference, link, image, price, struck-through price and discount, rating and review count, seller (Darty or a marketplace seller), strong points, trade-in and refund offers, delivery and pick-up promises, labels and energy class; the total; and every filter the shop shows (brand, category, promotions, delivery time, condition, customer rating, technical attributes). Filter with `facets[].values[].filter` values and sort by price, rating or newest. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/darty-search

parameters.name: filters
parameters.description: Filter values from `facets[].values[].filter` (e.g. m=RAPP-APLTR-APPLE), several separated by |.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
